content: प्लावित {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [प्लु णिच् क्त] .²1 Made to swim, float, or overflow. .²2 Deluged, inundated, overflowed. .²3 Moistened, wetted, sprinkled; गलन्मधुप्लावितदूरवर्त्मनि <ls>Śi. 12. 26</ls>; विविक्तेऽस्मिन्नगे भूयः प्लाविते जह्नुकन्यया <ls>Ki. 11. 36</ls>. .²4 Covered with, smeared. .²5 Lengthened, prolated (as a vowel); प्लावितेन स्वरेणोच्चैराजुहावाकुलेन्द्रियः <ls>Bhāg. 6. 1. 29</ls>. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Inundation, flood. .²2 A song in which the vowels are prolated.
